parameter_policy: Freeze each year's archived V14 frozen_w4 / V16 none parameters across all station cohorts; no new tuning
weight_policy: For w4 use raw 1+3*Beimen*planned_end_overlap, normalize mean weight to one within each selected event
feature_policy: Original historical-baseline and D1 planned-end groups; training-only preprocessing; no same-day lags or observed weather
selection_policy: Exploratory paired comparison; do not replace deployed four-station model based on these repeatedly inspected nine events
